title: The Diwali Bonus Heist
call: Inspector {name}, the Diwali bonuses were stolen during the Tara Tech office party.
Fifty envelopes of cash, gone. Nobody has left the building.
arrival: Fairy lights, half-eaten sweets, and eighty angry employees waiting for their bonus.

examination.title: Examine the gift box

spots.title: Ribbon
spots.text: Retied, but with a different knot from the shop's.

spots.title: Inside
spots.text: Empty. All fifty envelopes are gone.

spots.title: Bottom
spots.text: Tiny bits of coloured powder: pink, yellow and green.

examination.question: When were the envelopes taken?
options: 🪔 During the party, then the box was retied
examination.why: Someone retied the ribbon with a new knot, and left party powder inside. It happened tonight, during the party.

interview.alibi: I was judging the rangoli contest all evening.
replies: Sales did the rangoli, yes. All four of us.
gotchas: This wax is from the brass diyas YOU were lighting, Neha. It dripped on the ribbon while you retied it!
This gold zari thread matches the torn border of YOUR saree, Neha!

interview.alibi: I was singing on the karaoke stage. Everyone filmed me!
replies: I drew the peacock in the rangoli. So what?
Diyas? I never touched one. I was holding the mic all night.
My saree has a silver border, not gold. Look!
interview.release: Thirty phone videos show Pooja singing on stage all night.

interview.alibi: I was lighting a hundred diyas on the balcony. It took forever!
replies: Yes, I'm in Sales, and I did the rangoli.
I lit diyas, but on the balcony, far from the HR room. Ask the security guard.
My saree has no zari at all. It's plain silk, see?
interview.release: The security guard watched Farida light diyas on the balcony all evening.

leads.from: 🎁 Pink, yellow and green powder in the box
leads.question: Coloured powder, on Diwali night. What is it from?
wrongWhy: Holi is in March, not on Diwali!
Sweets leave sugar, not coloured powder.
leads.reveal: Rangoli! You check the rangoli contest sheet…
leads.name: Rangoli sheet
leads.found: Only one team made rangoli tonight: **SALES**. The sheet has their names, and the same powder all over it.
leads.ask: Cross out everyone who is NOT in Sales.
leads.why: Only the Sales team had rangoli powder on their hands.
leads.card: RANGOLI powder: only Sales made rangoli

leads.question: There are little drops of hard, smooth wax on the ribbon. Where did they drip from?
wrongWhy: Hand cream is soft and wet, not hard.
Cheese? At an office party? Focus, Inspector!
leads.reveal: A diya! You check the diyas on the 3rd floor…
leads.name: Diya wax
leads.found: The **wax** matches the big brass **diyas**. Someone retied the ribbon holding a lit diya, and caught a **gold thread** on the knot.
leads.ask: Tap everyone left who lit diyas tonight.
leads.why: Neha, Farida and Arun all lit diyas.

leads.from: 🧵 A gold thread caught in the knot
leads.question: The thread is real gold zari, the kind on a fancy border. What was the thief wearing?
wrongWhy: A plain kurta has no gold thread.
leads.reveal: A silk saree! Pandu checks the thread under his torch…
leads.name: Zari thread
leads.found: Real **zari** gold thread, torn from a **silk saree** border.
leads.ask: Cross out everyone left who is NOT wearing a silk saree.
leads.card: ZARI thread from a SILK SAREE

confession: "Twelve years in Sales, and this year they gave me no bonus. So I took everyone's."
escapeStory: Neha took a taxi straight to the airport. She was stopped at check-in with fifty envelopes in her handbag.
